If you can read this, the access phrase worked.

## How it works

The rendered HTML of this page was encrypted at build time with
AES-256-GCM (key derived via PBKDF2-SHA256, 310k iterations). Your
browser decrypted it locally using the WebCrypto API — the plaintext
never touches a server, and GitHub Pages only ever hosts ciphertext.

Posts marked `protected: true` in their front matter are encrypted
automatically by the publish workflow. If no password is configured,
the build fails closed: a placeholder ships instead of plaintext.
